scripts.build:www: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html', 'planner.html', 'planner.js', 'planner.css', 'style.css', 'script.js', 'icon-192.png', 'icon-512.png', 'site.webmanifest'].forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, path.join('www', f)); });"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
